run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T22:19:05Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog being rolled at 22:17:14Z to a pod template whose product-catalog container command is ["invalid-command"] with the same image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog). The container cannot start: exit code 128, reason StartError, 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH', leaving pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l not ready in CrashLoopBackOff (5 restarts) and the Deployment at Available=False / MinimumReplicasUnavailable with 1 unavailable replica. product-catalog server span rates are 0, and callers record error spans: frontend (4.065/s on GET, 3.392/s on grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct), checkout, recommendation and frontend-proxy. Frontend error-span rate was 0/s from 21:59:38Z through 22:17:38Z and rose after the rollout, matching the 22:19:05Z alert start. All flagd fault flags are off, so fault injection via flagd is not supported. Who or what applied the Deployment change could not be determined because change history is not integrated.

claims.text: At 2026-11-17T22:28:38Z frontend itself has error-status spans: GET 4.065091733/s, GET /api/products/{productId} 3.391633422/s, client span grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 3.391633422/s, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 0.673458311/s, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.425982667/s and tcp.connect 0.008113956/s (STATUS_CODE_ERROR).

Frontend's total STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate was 0/s at every 60s point from 2026-11-17T21:59:38Z through 22:17:38Z, then 1.722/s at 22:18:38Z, 14.038/s at 22:20:38Z, peak 28.230/s at 22:23:38Z and 17.972/s at 22:28:38Z, so the zero-error period is a comparable pre-incident baseline and the deviation begins after 22:17:38Z.

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (annotation deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=2) has container command ["invalid-command"] for container product-catalog with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog.

ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (replicas 0, owned by Deployment product-catalog) has command null and the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, while ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf (replicas 1, same owner) has command ["invalid-command"], showing the rollout changed only the container command.

Of 21 Deployments in otel-demo, only product-catalog has command ["invalid-command"]; every other workload has command null except flagd's legitimate ["/flagd-build","start","--port","8013","--ofrep-port","8016","--uri","file:./etc/flagd/demo.flagd.json"].

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf) is phase Running but container product-catalog ready=false with restartCount 5, state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff, and lastState terminated with exitCode 128, reason StartError, message 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'.

Events show Deployment product-catalog scaling up ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf at 22:17:14Z and scaling down product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc at 22:17:23Z, plus Pod Failed events carrying the identical exec-not-found error (6 occurrences on product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l between 22:17:35Z and 22:20:44Z) and BackOff with count 25 up to 22:22:46Z.

Deployment product-catalog status reports replicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1, condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable (transition 22:17:31Z) and message 'Deployment does not have minimum availability.'

product-catalog stopped serving: at 22:28:38Z the rate of oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts (STATUS_CODE_UNSET, server spans) was 0/s, so no increments of product-catalog server spans were recorded in that 5-minute lookback.

Other callers also record product-catalog call failures at 22:28:38Z: checkout oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 0.430039644/s and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.430039644/s; recommendation /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts 0.697800178/s and get_product_list 0.697800178/s; frontend-proxy ingress 4.588441867/s and router frontend egress 4.576270933/s error spans.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (demo.flagd.json) holds fault-injection flags all at defaultVariant "off", including productCatalogFailure (off), adFailure (off), cartFailure (off), paymentFailure (off), paymentUnreachable (off), recommendationCacheFailure (off), emailMemoryLeak (off), kafkaQueueProblems (off), loadGeneratorFloodHomepage (off) and imageSlowLoad (off).

Pod status across otel-demo at ~22:28:51Z shows product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l as the only pod with ready=false (restarts 5); the other 20 pods report ready=true, with fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 the only other pod having a nonzero (1) restart count while ready.

Frontend is not where the fault originates: every other Deployment in otel-demo has command null, its pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 started 21:47:14Z with ready=true and 0 restarts, and its errors concentrate on client span grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (3.392/s) while CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem and AdService/GetAds error rates are 0.

fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 shows Created/Started events at 22:07:17Z and 1 restart but is ready=true, and its error-status series were 0/s (flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 0, /ResolveInt 0), so that restart is a change during the window not tied to this alert.

Resource exhaustion (OOMKilled or eviction) of product-catalog is rejected: the container's last termination reason is StartError with exit code 128 and exec-not-found text, and no OOMKilled reason or Evicted event appears for product-catalog; the failures are repeated container-start failures of the same command.

flagd fault injection as the cause of the product-catalog failures is not supported: every flag in the flagd-config ConfigMap, including productCatalogFailure, is at defaultVariant "off" (value false), and a flag-based product failure would not produce the observed exec-not-found container start error.

Because the previous ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc had no command override and the same image, the fault was introduced by a change to the Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog pod template around 22:17:14Z (generation 4, revision 2); who or what applied that change is not visible in the available evidence.

gaps: Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so who or what modified Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (generation 4, revision 2) and the exact edit time cannot be determined; events only place the rollout at 22:17:14Z.

Jaeger queries returned no_data: traces_search for frontend (21:30:00Z-22:28:38Z and 22:13:00Z-22:28:38Z), traces_search_by_tags error=true for frontend (21:30:00Z-22:28:38Z) and traces_search for checkout (22:18:00Z-22:28:38Z); trace-level error details and exact gRPC status messages are therefore unavailable.

Prometheus holds no kube_* metric series (get_metric_names for {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned no_data; kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available queries returned no_data), so image_id digest comparison and readiness metrics could not be used; pod, ReplicaSet and Deployment objects (cluster state at ~22:28:51Z-22:29:40Z, after the queried window end) were used instead.

MutatingWebhookConfiguration objects could not be read (SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE), so a webhook that injected the command cannot be ruled out, although the persisted Deployment and ReplicaSet specs contain command ["invalid-command"].

Container logs gave no text: product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l's container never started (fetch_pod_logs returned no_data, and no previous instance exists) and the frontend log read for 22:17:00Z-22:28:38Z with an error filter returned no_data.
The pre-change product-catalog pod (product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm) was deleted at 22:17:23Z and its logs are no longer available, so its prior serving behaviour is not directly observed.
get_label_values for http_response_status_code on http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned no_data, so HTTP status-code label coverage could not be confirmed.
next_steps: Correct the product-catalog Deployment container command (remove the ["invalid-command"] override or restore the image's default entrypoint), let the rollout complete, then confirm the pod becomes ready and product-catalog server span rates return.
Retrieve Kubernetes audit/change history for Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog around 22:17:14Z to identify the actor that set the invalid command.
After remediation, re-check frontend, checkout, recommendation and frontend-proxy error rates against the pre-incident zero-error baseline (21:59:38Z-22:17:38Z).
